children: Charles & Colvard filed its monthly operating report for July 2026, disclosing that it sold its assets, ceased operations and reported an ending reconciled cash balance of $24,143.
Filed Chapter 11 monthly operating report for period ended July 31, 2026, attached as Exhibit 99.1.
Debtor completed closing on sale of its assets on July 1, 2026 and ceased operations for the period.
Total cash receipts in one account totaled $10,525; total disbursements $10,307; ending reconciled balance $24,143.
Debtor is working with counsel to formulate a Chapter 11 plan; cautions that equity holders may face significant or complete loss.
Post-petition administrative obligations remain unpaid ($11,984.41 to law firm; quarterly fee $17,410.00 noted).
